concerns.text: SC-005 cites '(See Methodological Soundness)' but no section titled 'Methodological Soundness' exists anywhere in the spec — the sensitivity-analysis rationale actually lives in the Assumptions section ('Assumption about threshold justification'). Stale cross-reference; re-point it.

Malformed and self-contradictory fallback rule: 'the project will use the closest available proxy or flag `MM-OCEAN provides video, transcript... the system MUST inject the generic neutral context profile...`'. The sentence offers two different fallbacks ('closest available proxy' vs 'neutral context profile') spliced together with an unclosed backtick. The Edge Cases section and the embedded text mandate ONLY the neutral-context fallback; pick one rule and repair the sentence.

concerns.location: spec.md:Success Criteria / Key Entities vs Constitution Principle VI
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI requires that every evaluation metric set (Rating, Reasoning, Grounding) include the 'Integration-failure Rate' (IR) reflecting whether the model cited the injected context. The spec defines only PR and HR in its Metric Record entity and SC-001..SC-005; IR appears nowhere in the spec. The spec's metric vocabulary is inconsistent with the project constitution it must satisfy.

concerns.location: spec.md:Assumptions, 'Assumption about computational resources' vs Constitution Principle VII
concerns.text: Assumption states 'no ... 8-bit/4-bit quantization requiring specialized hardware is used', while Constitution Principle VII mandates 'all inference runs MUST utilize quantized or smaller open-source MLLMs where necessary'. CPU-compatible quantization satisfies both only if the spec says so explicitly; as written the 'no quantization' phrasing reads as contradicting the constitution's quantization mandate. Clarify that CPU-tractable quantization is permitted.
